name.description: The server-assigned name, which is only unique within the same service that originally returns it. If you use the default HTTP mapping, the `name` should be a resource name ending with `operations/{unique_id}`.

enumDescriptions: A matcher has't been recognized.
A primary certificate that is served when SNI wasn't specified in the request or SNI couldn't be found in the map.
matcher.description: A predefined matcher for particular cases, other than SNI selection.

description.description: Optional. One or more paragraphs of text description of a certificate map entry.

labels.description: Optional. Set of labels associated with a Certificate Map Entry.

name.description: Identifier. A user-defined name of the Certificate Map Entry. Certificate Map Entry names must be unique globally and match pattern `projects/*/locations/*/certificateMaps/*/certificateMapEntries/*`.

certificates.description: Optional. A set of Certificates defines for the given `hostname`. There can be defined up to four certificates in each Certificate Map Entry. Each certificate must match pattern `projects/*/locations/*/certificates/*`.

enumDescriptions: The status is undefined.
The configuration is serving.
Update is in progress. Some frontends may serve this configuration.
state.description: Output only. A serving state of this Certificate Map Entry.

hostname.description: A Hostname (FQDN, e.g. `example.com`) or a wildcard hostname expression (`*.example.com`) for a set of hostnames with common suffix. Used as Server Name Indication (SNI) for selecting a proper certificate.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation timestamp of a Certificate Map Entry.

updateTime.description: Output only. The update timestamp of a Certificate Map Entry.

dnsAuthorizations.description: A list of dns authorizations for the parent resource.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

nextPageToken.description: If there might be more results than those appearing in this response, then `next_page_token` is included. To get the next set of results, call this method again using the value of `next_page_token` as `page_token`.

pemCertificate.description: Required. PEM certificate that is allowlisted. The certificate can be up to 5k bytes, and must be a parseable X.509 certificate.

DnsResourceRecord.description: The structure describing the DNS Resource Record that needs to be added to DNS configuration for the authorization to be usable by certificate.

name.description: Output only. Fully qualified name of the DNS Resource Record. e.g. `_acme-challenge.example.com`

data.description: Output only. Data of the DNS Resource Record.

type.description: Output only. Type of the DNS Resource Record. Currently always set to "CNAME".

labels.description: Optional. Set of labels associated with a Certificate.

sanDnsnames.description: Output only. The list of Subject Alternative Names of dnsName type defined in the certificate (see RFC 5280 4.2.1.6). Managed certificates that haven't been provisioned yet have this field populated with a value of the managed.domains field.

name.description: Identifier. A user-defined name of the certificate. Certificate names must be unique globally and match pattern `projects/*/locations/*/certificates/*`.

scope.description: Optional. Immutable. The scope of the certificate.
enumDescriptions: Use the DEFAULT scope if you plan to use the certificate with global external Application Load Balancer, global external proxy Network Load Balancer, or any of the regional Google Cloud services.
Use the EDGE_CACHE scope if you plan to use the certificate with Media CDN. The certificates are served from Edge Points of Presence. See https://cloud.google.com/vpc/docs/edge-locations.

Use the ALL_REGIONS scope if you plan to use the certificate with cross-region internal Application Load Balancer. The certificates are served from all Google Cloud regions. See https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones.
Associated with certificates used as client certificates in Backend mTLS.

tags.description: Optional. Input only. Immutable. Tag keys/values directly bound to this resource. For example: "123/environment": "production", "123/costCenter": "marketing"

description.description: Optional. One or more paragraphs of text description of a certificate.

expireTime.description: Output only. The expiry timestamp of a Certificate.

managed.description: If set, contains configuration and state of a managed certificate.

managedIdentity.description: If set, contains configuration and state of a managed identity certificate.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation timestamp of a Certificate.

updateTime.description: Output only. The last update timestamp of a Certificate.

selfManaged.description: If set, defines data of a self-managed certificate.

pemCertificate.description: Output only. The PEM-encoded certificate chain.

usedBy.description: Output only. The list of resources that use this Certificate.

resolvedData.description: Output only. The resolved CNAME chain. Empty list if the CNAME record for `CNAME.name` is not found. Otherwise the first item is the value of the CNAME record for `CNAME.name`. If the CNAME chain is longer, the second item is the value of the CNAME record for the first item, and so on.

expectedData.description: Output only. The expected value of the CNAME record for the domain, equals to `dns_resource_record.data` in the corresponding `DnsAuthorization`.

name.description: Output only. The name of the CNAME record for the domain, equals to `dns_resource_record.name` in the corresponding `DnsAuthorization`.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation timestamp of a DnsAuthorization.

updateTime.description: Output only. The last update timestamp of a DnsAuthorization.

name.description: Identifier. A user-defined name of the dns authorization. DnsAuthorization names must be unique globally and match pattern `projects/*/locations/*/dnsAuthorizations/*`.

dnsResourceRecord.description: Output only. DNS Resource Record that needs to be added to DNS configuration.

labels.description: Optional. Set of labels associated with a DnsAuthorization.

type.description: Optional. Immutable. Type of DnsAuthorization. If unset during resource creation the following default will be used: - in location `global`: FIXED_RECORD, - in other locations: PER_PROJECT_RECORD.
enumDescriptions: Type is unspecified.
FIXED_RECORD DNS authorization uses DNS-01 validation method.
PER_PROJECT_RECORD DNS authorization allows for independent management of Google-managed certificates with DNS authorization across multiple projects.

domain.description: Required. Immutable. A domain that is being authorized. A DnsAuthorization resource covers a single domain and its wildcard, e.g. authorization for `example.com` can be used to issue certificates for `example.com` and `*.example.com`.

description.description: Optional. One or more paragraphs of text description of a DnsAuthorization.

tags.description: Optional. Input only. Immutable. Tag keys/values directly bound to this resource. For example: "123/environment": "production", "123/costCenter": "marketing"

DnsAuthorization.description: A DnsAuthorization resource describes a way to perform domain authorization for certificate issuance.
